hi, i'm alex

I'm a sophomore at MIT studying computer science (6-3).

I've worked at a NASA wind tunnel, tracked a near earth asteriod, fine-tuned a LLM to help researchers revise papers, and built planes with wingspans from 6 inches to 12 feet. It's a lot of different things. But I'm most interested in applying my software experience to aerospace, specifically to controls, computer vision, and autonomy.

I love tuna sashimi, ducks, sci-fi, and anything that flies.

coursework

Some highlights:

Software Construction (6.1020)

TypeScript. Including specifications, abstract data types, unit testing, regular expressions, concurrency.

Computation Structures (6.1910)

Combinational and sequential circuits, memory hierarchy, operating systems. Built a RISC-V 4 stage pipelined processor in Minispec.

Design and Analysis of Algorithms (6.1220)

Dynamic programming, greedy algorithms, randomized algorithms, minimum spanning trees, network flow, linear programming, intractability, approximation algorithms, multiplicative weights, Markov chains.
